Running.note: Read-only row in the ⑂ chip's popover: fork glyph, description title, and the Running · model · background meta line.

CompletedWithSummary.note: Positive tone on the status word, duration label derived from usage.durationSeconds, and the completion summary on its own line — fits without truncation at the panel width.

Failed.note: Danger tone applied to both the glyph and the status word.

ClickableRoster.note: onOpen turns each row into an unstyled Button with hover/active states; also covers the description-less fixture that falls back to agentType (cursor/task).
